Field Notes / Rental guide

What Affects Temporary Fence Rental Cost?

How fence type, footage, gates, site access, and rental length shape your quote—and what Fence Wizards includes.

Request a quoteCall Richard(317) 296-4015

Rental guide · Fence Wizards

Fence Wizards quotes a flat fee

Fence Wizards prices the job for an agreed term. Delivery, installation, and removal are included. The standard rental runs up to 12 months, and short jobs of a few months or less receive discounted pricing.

This is why a monthly price per foot does not describe the whole offer. Ask for a quote based on your actual site and scope, then compare what is included.

Fence type and installation work

Panels and stands are fast to install and move. They are often the practical starting point for a changing site, a paved lot, or an event.

Post-driven chain link involves driving posts and hanging the fabric. That additional labor affects the quote. It can be useful for a longer fixed boundary where portability is less important.

Footage, gates, and duration

The total run determines how much material and installation work are needed. Rough measurements are useful at the start; a site plan can help refine them.

Gate count and position matter too. A wide delivery entrance and several pedestrian openings create a different layout from a simple closed perimeter. Tell Richard what needs to enter and where.

Include the expected duration even if the completion date is provisional. Short-term work can be priced differently from a standard rental.

Ground, access, and distance

A truck that can unload beside the run makes a different installation from a tight frontage where material needs carrying. Paved ground, rock, slopes, and fill also affect the fencing system and the work required.

Travel to a site near the edge of the service area is included in the quoted number and discussed with you. Give the full address early.

Compare the complete quote

Check the agreed rental term, delivery, installation, removal, and any additional items. Windscreen is sold rather than rented, so include it when comparing scopes.

Richard can review a written quote from another company and explain how the Fence Wizards offer compares. The family-owned operation and direct material purchasing help keep pricing competitive.

Changes after the quote

A delay within the agreed rental term does not change the rental fee. If the term needs extending, call before it ends. Added footage, gates, or other scope changes should be discussed with Richard.

Net 30 is available for vetted accounts. Smaller or unvetted accounts pay up front, with the applicable terms explained at the start. PlotQuote is coming soon; use the contact form or call for a quote in the meantime.
